decisions.reason: The badge replacement and related icon choices are already fully represented by the candidate's message 114 MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Replacing a First Mint badge with a First Referral badge does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset behavior.
The badge-catalog decision does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, carryover, or reset behavior.
The source changes a displayed badge, not the allocation of primary-mint revenue.
Naming a badge First Referral does not alter the referral commission amount or automatic payout mode.
The icon and badge-catalog discussion is unrelated to the project's product name or prospective platform name.
The First Referral badge replacement does not change ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
The source does not change the Big Block prize amount, winner count, trigger, funding, or eligibility.
The badge-catalog change has no effect on random winner selection, eligible ticket populations, or probability weighting.
The source does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, trigger, recurrence, funding, or eligibility.
The badge replacement does not alter the winner-initiated prize claim or payout flow.
The source decision concerns badge presentation and does not change secondary-royalty enforcement or the use of royalty proceeds.
